selection_note: Timing and severity fixed before any disturbed-policy rollout. Rectangle chosen using the existing state-0 clean scene; this is a developmental pilot.
step_convention: Zero-based policy action index, excluding settling. Disturbed inputs at steps 30..59 inclusive; normal input resumes at 60. Simulator camera is 256x256; transform applied after rotation and before cloud model preprocessing.
scope: One task; two transient sensor-input perturbations; no physical lighting or object-displacement intervention.
